protocol.batching: Deterministically shuffle all training items without reading gold, then split into four groups of 32
protocol.calibration: None; student probabilities are softmax candidate scores, not teacher confidence
protocol.claim: Hard-label distillation from explicitly requested Astra Codex workers; not the original Responses API arm
protocol.codex_usage_cost: Unavailable; do not claim free compute or fabricate usage counters
protocol.controls: Reuse the completed original gold and untrained fits, with result hashes fixed before teacher queries
protocol.evaluation: Same 172 previously scored public pilot items; reused development, not independent confirmation
protocol.fit: Unchanged CandidateStudent and fit_student; all encoder weights plus candidate-scoring head
protocol.model_identity: Explicit parent spawn configuration, not independently provider-attested API identity
protocol.reasoning_and_output_limit: Low effort requested; no API-equivalent hard output-token limit exposed by spawn
protocol.response: Strict batch_id plus choices of opaque item ID and candidate ID only
protocol.selection: All three final fits, fixed recipe, no teacher-label correction, no tuning or best-seed selection
protocol.worker_access: Instruction allowlist: read assigned packet, write assigned response; no other tools or files
protocol.worker_isolation: Fresh conversation; shared filesystem is not a technical isolation boundary
